en_h: After your transplant, what did your medical team tell you about your fistula?
qen: Reply to this story. It comes to my DMs, nobody else sees it.
ar: بعد الزراعة، شو قلّك فريقك الطبي عن الفيستولا؟
qar: ردّ عالستوري، بتوصل عالخاص وما حدا غيري بيشوفها.
en: After your transplant, what did your medical team tell you about your fistula?
